instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace index.css theme tokens with the provided --sg-* colors and @fontsource-variable imports.
2. Build the app as a modular single-page landing site in frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx with rich, standalone sub-components in frontend/src/components/landing/.
3. Implement the 3D Hero Shield using Three.js Canvas / WebGL or Canvas2D fallback with rotating binary rings, glowing ambient lights, and floating interactive glass metric pills.

4. Ensure the Guided Product Tour simulator is thoroughly interactive: clicking between the 8 sidebar tabs (Dashboard, Monitoring, Alerts, Policies, Risks, Evidence, Frameworks, AI Chat) updates the canvas view seamlessly.

5. Provide mock dynamic state in the AI Chat demo allowing users to click sample prompt chips ('Assess our NIS2 exposure', 'Generate DORA Incident Report', 'Verify ISO 42001 Model Registry') and see streaming responses.
6. Include data-testid on every interactive button, tab, flip-card trigger, form input, and CTA.
